pois.label: SiC 探测舱(剖切)
pois.detail: 柱头剖开的一面就是整条探测因果链:朝堆侧 HDPE 慢化帽把 MeV 级泄漏中子撞软 → ⁶LiF 转换层(30 µm)把热中子变成带电产物 → 4H-SiC PiN 片 2×2(左列贴 LiF 走热道,右列裸片走快道,硅碳反冲+阈值反应)→ 铜读出板 → 前放。中子进、电脉冲出,没有黑盒。
pois.detail_en: The cut-open head is the whole causal chain: the reactor-facing HDPE cap softens MeV leakage neutrons → a 30 µm ⁶LiF converter turns thermals into charged products → a 2×2 stack of 4H-SiC PiN pads (left column behind LiF = thermal channel, right column bare = fast channel via Si/C recoils and threshold reactions) → copper readout board → preamp. Neutrons in, pulses out, no black box.

specs.前端死时间: **≤1 µs(设计要求)**——门控次序不变式的线性前提;10 µs 时 F≳2.5e4 起带电道饱和,方向削弱门控

specs_en.Front-end dead time: **≤1 µs (design requirement)** — the linearity premise of the ordering invariant; at 10 µs the charged channel saturates above F≈2.5e4, eroding the gate

pois.sim: LiF 厚度账(design_rounds 账1):透射几何效率峰 4.72% @ 29.9 µm;Σ_th=54.6 cm⁻¹(俘获平均自由程 183 µm),产物射程 α 5.9 / t 33 µm 封顶自吸收;10 µm 只有 3.0%、60 µm 回落 4.0%——定版 30 µm 落峰肩:**≥95% 峰值的厚度带是 22.5–40.5 µm,即 ±9 µm 内效率损失 <5%**——「容差平坦」到此有了判据,超出该带即不成立。**该效率完全依赖 95% ⁶Li 富集这一设计选择**:换天然 LiF(7.5% ⁶Li)则掉 **11.4 倍**(4.72% → 0.41%),且重新优化厚度也救不回(最优 33 µm 仅 0.42%)。账里 ρ=2.54 g/cm³ 与 M=25.0 g/mol 用的是**富集态**的配对值(天然为 2.64/25.94),二者自洽。
pois.sim_en: LiF thickness account (design_rounds #1): transmission-geometry efficiency peaks at 4.72% at 29.9 µm; Σ_th=54.6 cm⁻¹ (183 µm capture mean free path), product ranges α 5.9 / t 33 µm cap the self-absorption; 10 µm gives only 3.0% and 60 µm falls back to 4.0% — the 30 µm design point sits on the flat shoulder, and «flat» now carries a criterion: the band holding ≥95% of peak is 22.5–40.5 µm, i.e. ±9 µm costs under 5% efficiency — outside that band the claim does not hold. **That efficiency rests entirely on the 95% ⁶Li enrichment, a design choice**: natural LiF (7.5% ⁶Li) costs a factor of **11.4** (4.72% → 0.41%), and re-optimising the thickness does not recover it (33 µm gives only 0.42%). The ledger uses ρ=2.54 g/cm³ with M=25.0 g/mol — the **enriched** pair (natural would be 2.64/25.94); the two are mutually consistent.
pois.physics: ⁶Li(n,α)t,Q=4.78 MeV(α 2.05 + t 2.73 MeV),热截面 940 b。效率峰是一场竞争:层厚→俘获多但产物出不来;层薄→产物全出但俘获少。α 在 SiC 里生成 ~26 万 e-h 对(W=7.8 eV),比 MIP 大两个量级——所以这里用 PiN 就够,不需要增益。
pois.physics_en: ⁶Li(n,α)t, Q=4.78 MeV (α 2.05 + t 2.73 MeV), 940 b thermal cross-section. The peak is a competition: thicker converts more but self-absorbs the products; thinner lets products out but converts less. One α makes ~260k e-h pairs in SiC (W=7.8 eV), two orders above a MIP — a plain PiN suffices, no gain needed.

pois.label: 计数屏 · 围界预期账
pois.detail: 小屏有节奏地跳——每 ~12 秒一个脉冲点。这不是装饰:它就是托卡马克屏蔽账在围界的活体读数,跳的是聚变堆泄漏,不是宇宙线。
pois.detail_en: The little screen blips rhythmically — one pulse every ~0.43 s. Not decoration: it is the tokamak shielding budget read out live at the fence, and what blips is fusion leakage, not cosmic rays.

specs.预期计数率: 2.32 cps(热道 2.07 + 快道 0.25)——已分辨口径,建造厚度 0.30 m;旧 0.08 已作废
specs.报警灵敏度: 泄漏 ×10 → 60 s 积分 √N 判 3σ

specs_en.Expected rate: 2.32 cps (thermal 2.07 + fast 0.25), resolved chain at the 0.30 m build thickness; the old 0.08 is void

−sin a) 反解,本组位于端口角 **a=270°**,正落在 250°/290° 两端口间 40° 间隙的中点,**最近端口偏离 20°**(58 m 处横向错开 20 m)——相对有利,不是正对。但**该堆的中子学台账本身零端口零贯穿件**(圆柱层模型),端口分辨的输运计算不存在;且现有 9 窗口是 LHCD 时代布局,v5 已改 ECCD、发射器几何未定 ⇒ **不能宣告"无视线",结论暂定**。**并且孔道流是「无界项」,裕量覆盖不了**(sci-rad-01 裕量预算经总控转达:H*(10) ×1.30 × 散射返回 ×2.0 = 可覆盖 2.6,而孔道流列「无界」)⇒ **按裕量选出的屏蔽厚度不得被描述为对贯穿件安全 —— 那一项必须闭合,不能覆盖。**本网共签并持有该声明。⇒ 通则:**裕量是对付能界定项的工具,对付不能界定的项是错的工具。****材料内直测已出(2026-08-07)**(本句原续写「净判决方向不保守」,该判决 2026-08-08 已撤回,见下文逐轴定位):固定前置、只变屏蔽厚度,中段(0.025–0.15 m,约 2 个 TVL)三区间 TVL 0.0810/0.0818/0.0775,**误差内恒定 ≈0.080**⇒ **小跨度内单一 TVL 模型成立**;但最深段 0.1048,**较中段长 31%**(2.2σ,谱重新硬化)。**本网原在此判「两效应同向 ⇒ 净方向不保守」,该判决 2026-08-08 自查撤回,改判「净方向未定」**:两条观测确实共享同一条物理规矩(局部谱越硬 → TVL 越长),但偏置方向还取决于本网用例落在每条轴的**哪一端**,而这一步我没做。逐轴定位后:① 上游慢化轴——本网在整机之后,比其任何一档都厚 ⇒ 该用**更短**的 TVL ⇒ 拿其薄上游档的值会算得**偏厚**⇒**保守**;② 材料内深度轴——本网 25 个 TVL,比其任何一档都深 ⇒ 该用**更长**的 TVL ⇒ 拿中段值会算得**偏薄**⇒**不保守**。**两个修正方向相反,净方向未定**(①现测到 −52% 大于②的 +31%,但②可能沿 25 个 TVL 累积,谁大同样未定)。⇒ **同因不蕴含同向。****补一层机理(托卡马克 2026-08-08)**:两轴机理相反——①是异材慢化致软化(LiPb 靠 Pb 非弹压软谱),②是同材深穿透致选择性硬化(软成分先死光)。由此它自报一条对本网不利的限定:①测的是「先慢化再吸收」的**复合叠层**,而本网是**单一均质混凝土内部**,**①对本网的适用性本身存疑** ⇒ 两条腿支撑度不对等(①受跨度+构型两重限制,②只受跨度限制),**「未定」是不对称的未定:②那条腿站得稳些,而②指向不保守侧**。(这不恢复本网原判——原判错在没有逐轴定位,该结构性错误与哪条腿更强无关。)⇒ 工程措辞不变——**外推超出实测跨度时须往厚了取,不得直接线性外推**——但依据从"已知偏不保守"降为"**符号未知,故取保守侧**"。**硬限定**:其数据最深 0.20 m ≈ 2.5 个 TVL,而本网 2 m 级混凝土约 **25 个 TVL 且材料不同**⇒ 该实验**不支持对本网区间的任何定量结论**,只支持上面那条定性方向。
pois.sim_en: Perimeter counting account (design_rounds #2; the **source term was rebuilt in full** after the tokamak reply of 2026-08-07). **Anchor**: S_n = 2.27e20 n/s @14.06 MeV at the v5 640 MW operating point (the older 3.01e20 was an 848 MW figure and is retracted). **One retraction**: this account had used 1.9e14 as a "flux leaving the shield". It is in fact the REBCO lifetime **design limit at the TF winding, inside the cryostat, behind 0.12 m of WC-B4C** — wrong in position, in nature and in power scaling. **Assumed here with no operator counterpart**: the reactor ledger has **no biological shield at all** (its Geant4 geometry stops at the TF coils), so the 2 m of borated concrete and TVL 0.25 m are entirely this network's own. **The method itself also carries a limitation** (raised by sci-rad-01 via control, 2026-08-08, checked and adopted here): **multiplying TVLs systematically under-predicts the residual behind a thick shield** — the residual is dominated by secondary build-up, which a single TVL either omits entirely (if it is a total-cross-section value) or captures only at its calibration depth (if it is a measured effective value), while assuming it does not grow with thickness. Their evidence: the village's residual behind 2 m of regolith is **7.6 mSv/yr**, against 1.540 for the pure-exponential primary branch — **a factor of 4.93**. (**Superseded, 2026-08-08**: this 6.2 is void — the village moved lambda_p from 44 to **67.1** (the 44 misused the MOLA-datum atmospheric column and was corrected when the cited party, mars_rad account 1, retracted), so the residual is **7.6 mSv/yr** (234 -> 7.6, 31x). Re-checked here: lambda_p=67.1, f_n=0.10 gives 7.586. The factor is therefore fixed at **4.93 = 7.586/1.540** (village total over village primary branch, both at 67.1); **it is a decomposition-dependent ratio** — moving f_n from 0.10 to 0.122 shifts the total by 17% but the ratio by 20%, so **f_n=0.10 must be quoted alongside it**.) (**The meaning of this factor of 3.63 is pending clarification, 2026-08-08**: the village's disclosed two-branch form D=234x[(1-f_n)e^(-x/44)+f_n*B*e^(-x/170)] with f_n=0.10, B=1.8 reproduces 6.16 at 330 g/cm² (matching 6.2), **but its fast branch alone gives 0.117, not 1.71** — so if the phrase without build-up means that branch, the factor is **53x**; 1.71 back-solves to lambda=67, inconsistent with lambda_p=44, and looks more like the pessimistic end of an envelope. **Asked; until it is settled this network quotes only the direction (under-prediction), not the factor. pois.detail: 柱里的探测片与 LGAD 项目(PAN 硅微条改造)同一条外延栈——同样的 50 µm n⁻ 漂移层,只是免掉增益层注入做成 PiN。一次 TCAD 战役,两处收获:PiN 版守围界,LGAD 增益版(d17,M≈5)留给轨道上的 PAN 谱仪升级。宽禁带 3.26 eV 是这里的全部选型理由:室温漏电为零、盲可见光、耐辐照——零冷却、零遮光,火星昼夜温差直接裸跑。
pois.detail_en: The pads share the epitaxial stack of the LGAD project (the PAN silicon-strip conversion) — same 50 µm n⁻ drift layer, minus the gain implant, making a PiN. One TCAD campaign, two deployments: the PiN guards the fence, the gain version (d17, M≈5) is reserved for the orbital PAN upgrade. The 3.26 eV bandgap is the whole selection argument: zero room-temperature leakage, visible-blind, radiation-hard — no cooling, no light-tightening, bare through Martian day-night swings.

pois.sim_en: Leakage-vs-temperature account (design_rounds #4): SRH generation model — the same geometry in Si leaks ~nA at 300 K and reaches µA by 350 K, demanding cooling; SiC stays <1e-20 A at 450 K. pois.physics: 生成电流 ∝ n_i ∝ exp(−Eg/2kT):禁带每宽 1 eV,室温本征载流子少 ~8 个数量级。Si 器件在聚变堆围界要制冷要避光;SiC 把这两项预算直接归零——这就是 14 MeV 中子监测的教科书选型。
pois.physics_en: Generation current ∝ n_i ∝ exp(−Eg/2kT): each extra eV of bandgap buys ~8 decades fewer intrinsic carriers at room temperature. A Si device on a fusion fence needs cooling and light-tightening; SiC zeroes both budgets — the textbook choice for 14 MeV neutron monitoring.

pois.label: 中子哨兵网 · 三层联动
pois.detail: 同款柱子布在三个世界:这里(围界,地表)、地下城玄关(30 m 岩下)、深地实验室(3000 m 岩下)。三块屏并排读,就是每层岩石各自吃掉的数量级:围界每 ~0.43 s 一跳(已分辨口径;旧 ~12 s 系自设 2 m 档),玄关每 ~1 分钟偶尔一跳,深地几乎纹丝不动——静默本身就是屏蔽账的活体证明。太阳粒子事件里的分工也照这条线划:**真正给 EVA 撤收买到提前量的只有 com-l4-01 日冕仪那一级**(看 CME 起飞,1–3 天结构预报);极轨 EPS 的 ~77 min 是**自由空间的谱弥散间隔**,对轨道资产与事件表征可动作,却不是地表余量——到达时间随能量单调变短,能穿到地面的 >166 MeV 那条带**无能量上界**——首批相对论粒子 ~17 min(光行时硬下限)就到,截止能附近的那批 32 min 才到,**整条带比该窗口所锚的 100 MeV 前锋(39.5 min)先到**;而**轨道对地表剂量起始的领先是 0**:首批相对论粒子确实比剂量主体早 ~15 min 到(2.04 AU 光行时 16.9–17.0 min 是硬下限),但 GeV 级质子远在 166 MeV 大气截止之上,**地表同刻就看得见**——这 15 min 轨道与地表共享,不构成谁对谁的提前量(且要吃满 15 min 得靠相对论尾巴,1 GeV 只买到 12.8 min)。**撤收因此是事件驱动而非窗口驱动:红警即回舱,不按窗口算**——真实余量是剂量累积问题、随事件大小走,最坏档比 77 min 还短(规范值在 sci-rad-01 的剂量卡:F=10⁴ 档仅 ~27 min)。地表被 ~20 g/cm² 大气柱吃掉低能段,物理上报不出早期警报。本网的职责在下游:证实次级场到达、记剂量账,并用地下两柱的零响应给出避难深度的实测衰减下限。
pois.detail_en: The same column stands in three worlds: here at the fence (surface), the undercity foyer (under 30 m of rock), and the deep lab (under 3000 m). Read the three screens side by side and you read the decades each rock layer eats: ~0.43 s blips at the fence (resolved chain; the old ~12 s was the assumed-2 m case), an occasional blip per minute in the foyer, near-total stillness in the deep — the silence itself is the shielding budget, alive. Solar particle events split along the same line: **the only tier that actually buys EVA evacuation lead time is the com-l4-01 coronagraph** (catching the CME lift-off, a 1–3 day structural forecast). The polar EPS's ~77 minutes is a **free-space spectral dispersion interval** — actionable for orbital assets and event characterisation, but not ground margin: arrival time shortens monotonically with energy, and the >166 MeV band that penetrates to the surface has **no upper energy bound** — its first relativistic members land at ~17 min (the light-travel floor) and those near the cutoff at ~32 min, so **the whole band beats the 100 MeV front (39.5 min) the window is anchored on**; and **orbit leads the onset of surface dose by exactly zero**: the first relativistic particles do arrive ~15 min ahead of the dose main body (the 16.9–17.0 min light-travel time over 2.04 AU is the hard floor), but GeV protons sit far above the 166 MeV atmospheric cutoff, so **the ground sees them at the same instant** — those 15 min are shared by orbit and ground alike and are nobody's lead over anybody (and collecting the full 15 needs the relativistic tail: 1 GeV buys only 12.8 min). **Evacuation is therefore event-driven, not window-driven: on a red alert everyone returns immediately — you do not compute against the window.** The real margin is a dose-accumulation problem that scales with event size, and in the worst bracket it is shorter than 77 min (the normative figures live on the sci-rad-01 dose card: ~27 min at F=10⁴). Ground instruments, under ~20 g/cm² of atmosphere that eats the low-energy end, physically cannot raise an early alarm. This network works downstream: confirm the secondary field has arrived, keep the dose ledger, and turn the two underground columns' zero response into a measured lower bound on shelter attenuation.

sim_en: Depth-attenuation account (design_rounds #3): surface GCR neutrons ~0.05 n/cm²/s; 30 m of rock annihilates the hadronic component (e^-52), leaving a radiogenic neutron floor ~1e-5 and a muon residual ×0.03; at 3000 m the muons are ×1e-6 (cross-checked against the sci-deeplab-01 shaft card) and neutrons drop to the bare-rock U/Th (α,n) floor ~1e-6 n/cm²/s.

SEP response account (design_rounds #5, interfacing the com-gap space-weather chain): for a surface enhancement of F, the charged channel goes 0.40 cps → F×, reaching 5σ in ~188 s at F=2, ~8 s at F=10, and within a second beyond F=50; the two underground columns have no response channel at all (SEP secondaries cross the same 52 hadronic e-folds in 30 m of rock). Confirmation on the charged channel therefore lands within seconds. **That is not lead time**: the surface dose is carried by the >166 MeV hard band, fully arrived by 27.8–32.2 min, so confirmation is essentially simultaneous with the onset of surface dose — ground lead time is ~0 — and in fact the penetrating band lands about 7 min before the EPS 100 MeV front alarm it is often compared against. The 77 minutes are defined on the free-space 10 MeV main flux, and that flux never reaches the ground at all (166 MeV atmospheric cutoff) — **lead time can only be bought further upstream (the L4 coronagraph, 1–3 days); neither the EPS tier nor the ground can buy any**. What this network delivers is arrival confirmation, the dose ledger and the measured underground attenuation, not warning time.

False-alarm gate (account #5, safety-critical; numbers corrected by sci-rad-01 account #6): the neutron channel sits on a 2.32 cps fusion pedestal (resolved chain) and an SEP lifts only its 0.0016 cps GCR share — a moderate event (F=2) adds a harmless +1.1%. But a 1972-class hard-spectrum event (F=1e4) drove the neutron channel to read as a ×112 leak (5σ in 3 s, indistinguishable from a catastrophic fusion leak) **under the assumed-2 m case**. **[Severity moved, 2026-09-02 — reads against this network, and must be read together with the sentence above]** With the pedestal 29x higher under the resolved chain, the same F=1e4 hard-spectrum event now drives the neutron channel to only **×4.8** (the **now-void** ×112 was the assumed-2 m case); moderate events barely register. => **The necessity of the gate is unchanged** (it rests on the ratio of fractional responses, which does not move with the pedestal), **but the premise that earned it the safety-critical grade — that it reads as a catastrophic leak — no longer holds.** **Control has ruled: the requirement is kept.** The conditional severity table lives in tokamak's SAFETY_REQ_sep_gating.md (L205-246) and at sci-rad-01's co-signature, all three printing **this ledger's ×4.8 and 39×→1171×** (the earlier ×4.7 / 41×→1191× came from rounding R_gcr to 0.0016). Control's reason is more fundamental than this network's original one: **a safety item is not withdrawn because one movable parameter moved.** **Interest declared**: the same re-anchoring raised this network's ordering margin from 39x to 1171x, which favours this network — and this network is also the party reporting the weakened severity. Both are reported together. Gating the neutron channel on the charged channel is therefore safety-critical: charged fires first = SEP; a quiet charged channel with rising neutrons = a real leak. **The ordering is provably safe**: only 2.03% of the neutron channel is GCR-fed while the charged channel is almost all GCR, so their fractional responses differ by 22–90×; when the charged channel reaches the yellow state and opens the gate, the neutron channel has moved just 2.2–9.0%. For an SEP to arrive "neutron-first" and beat the gate would need a scaling above 49, against a computed 0.5–2.2. **This margin has a precondition**: it rests on only 2.03% of the neutron channel being GCR-fed, and that fraction is GCR-share/(leak pedestal + GCR-share) — **the smaller the leak pedestal, the thinner the margin**. In invariant form the criterion is **independent of the shield**: ordering holds iff the leak pedestal exceeds GCR-share × (max scaling − 1) = 0.0020 cps, against a present pedestal of 2.32 cps — a **1171x margin** (resolved chain; the old 39x was the assumed-2 m case). The right-hand side contains only this column's instrument parameter and a spectral quantity; the thickness, material and TVL the tokamak reports move only the left. Crossing it has two adjacent thresholds: below 0.0020 cps the ordering margin vanishes for soft spectra, and below 0.0016 cps (GCR fraction >50%) the **neutron channel flips from fusion-leak-dominated to GCR-dominated — at which point it no longer measures the reactor but space weather**, a change of instrument identity rather than a thinner margin. Once the tokamak confirms its shield design, only one comparison is needed: new pedestal against 0.0020 cps. **The gate can only rest on the inter-channel difference in fractional response, never on arrival timing** — a timing criterion fails precisely in the hard-spectrum regime (neutron lag: 30 min soft, −0.3 min hard, i.e. none); sci-rad-01 computed this and rejected it, so do not rebuild it. Source of truth: sci-rad-01 evaluates on its own chip and publishes the event state, which this gate **consumes**; the normative threshold definition lives only on its alert card and is not restated here. **Failure degradation (hard requirement)**: if the orbital preset or the event state suffers a link loss, a stale bulletin or a doubtful state, it degrades to **no preset** — a neutron rise is then treated as a real leak, and it must **never fail into the "SEP suspected" state**, which is the one direction that can hide a real leak. The local charged channel gate is always on duty, and **removing the upstream preset does not affect the correctness of the gate** (the preset is non-load-bearing; it buys attribution speed, not safety). Implementation constraint: **FLAG, never SUBTRACT** — removing a modelled SEP neutron contribution is the one failure mode that can hide a real leak during an event. Architecture caveat: the polar EPS bulletin is an independent **prior**, uncoupled from reactor state, but a prior is not a discriminator: it cannot rule out the low-probability, high-consequence branch where a real leak coincides with the storm. Only the co-located, same-instant charged channel can. Multiply EPS by the charged channel; never substitute one for the other. **Architectural convergence — three independent reasons point to the same decision**: (1) the SEP false-trigger risk; (2) the perimeter channel has zero discrimination as to which loop breached; and (3) it **pulls against the shield-thickness criterion** — a thicker shield keeps people safer but makes the signal dimmer and the monitoring blunter, a thinner one the reverse. That is a genuine design conflict, not a flaw in the derivation. **The resolution is not a compromise thickness but keeping the perimeter column out of first-judgment on leaks**: once it only confirms and logs boundary dose, the shield thickness is set purely by the occupational dose limit and the tension dissolves. Three independent reasons converging is far stronger than one. **The invariant's linearity precondition (checked here for the first time)**: it assumes neither channel saturates at any F. Measured: with a 1 µs front end, at F=1e4 the charged channel runs 4000 cps for just 0.40% dead time and the neutron channel stays under 0.001% — so **the 1972-class range is linear and the invariant holds**. But **it has an upper limit of validity**: with a 10 µs front end, the charged channel begins to saturate appreciably above F ≈ 2.5e4, and **saturation pushes the wrong way** — it flattens the charged channel while the neutron channel keeps rising, narrowing the very gap the gate rests on. ⇒ **Front-end dead time becomes a design requirement (target ≤1 µs), and the invariant is scoped to F ≲ 1e4.** **The two inputs on the right-hand side of the invariant — load-bearing yet, until now, nearly invisible on this card**: the GCR ambient floor of **0.0016 cps** (this network's own surface secondary-neutron flux of 0.05 /cm²/s put through the stack response) and the hard-spectrum scaling **s_max = 2.223** (computed by sci-rad-01, account #6, soft-spectrum case). **The whole right-hand side of R_leak > R_gcr(s_max−1) is fixed by those two numbers** — they are stated here not because they are uncertain but because **they carry weight while staying invisible**: how prominent a number is in the narrative bears no relation to how much it carries, and a card should rank its emphasis by load, not by story order. **The two conclusions do not carry the same confidence — do not read them together**: the **qualitative** claim that ordering holds survives an S_n reduction of roughly 40×, whereas the **numerical** 39× margin scales directly with S_n. And S_n's provenance chain runs: this network ← the reactor's v5 operating point of 640 MW ← **TORAX QLKNN/TGLF-NN surrogate models**, which the reactor's own ledger flags as its fidelity boundary (post-sawtooth Te0 sits at the edge of the training domain) and which **neither it nor this network can independently verify**. So the surrogate's uncertainty **does not threaten "ordering holds"**; it only moves the 39×. The other external load-bearing input, s_max = 2.223, comes from sci-rad-01 account #6 and **is independently verifiable** — this network has re-derived its arithmetic line by line. **The number that matters most on the right-hand side of the criterion is one this network simply picked**: the GCR ambient floor of 0.0016 cps is converted from a self-assumed surface secondary-neutron flux of 0.05 /cm²/s, **never checked against RAD measurements**. It is **load-bearing for the criterion** — the only input to the right-hand side that originates here — whereas S_n, for all that its provenance chain is longer and more conspicuous, only carries the numerical margin. **Until this dependency table was filled in, attention had been on S_n.** Mitigation: the invariant is **linear** in this quantity and the present margin is 39×, so it would have to be underestimated by a factor of 39 to overturn the conclusion, while the plausible range of that flux is about ±3× — **the conclusion holds, but this mitigation only surfaced because the table forced it out; it had never been written down.**

pois.physics_en: Hadrons vanish exponentially in rock with λ≈150 g/cm²; muons only grind down by ionization and penetrate far deeper, so the shallow-underground 'occasional blip' is almost pure µ; by 3 km even the muons are gone and only the rock's own radioactivity is left talking.
